trust_decision.summary: Whether a SAML assertion's NameID email may log in / be linked to an existing Prowler user and grant a tenant: at the pinned commit the adapter links any existing user by asserted email alone, and the ACS finish view picks the tenant from the asserted email domain instead of binding it to the ACS slug's tenant.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'SAML domain claiming' and the ACS; TenantFinishACSView is the obvious SAML login handler with the domain lookup, tenant membership grant and token issuance.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/v1/accounts/saml/<organization_slug>/acs/ (allauth ACSView -> pre_social_login hook, via SOCIALACCOUNT_ADAPTER)
fix_sites.module_kind: framework adapter/hook (allauth social account adapter), separate file from views

fix_sites.entry_point: GET/POST /api/v1/accounts/saml/<organization_slug>/acs/finish/ (new email-domain vs slug vs configured-domain check inserted here)
GET/POST /api/v1/accounts/saml/<organization_slug>/acs/finish/ (tenant derived from asserted email domain, removed)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: api/src/backend/api/adapters.py:17-25 (allauth adapter hook pre_social_login, reached from allauth's ACSView at api/src/backend/api/v1/urls.py:197-199, not from Prowler's view code)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The adapter is generic allauth plumbing shared with Google/GitHub where email auto-linking is intended (settings enable SOCIALACCOUNT_EMAIL_AUTHENTICATION_AUTO_CONNECT globally), so a solver that hardens the finish view can argue linking-by-email is a deliberate project-wide policy and the view check suffices.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-SAML providers (Google/GitHub) must still auto-link to an existing local account by email, and a legitimate SAML user who is already a member of the domain's tenant must still be linked and logged in; an over-broad fix that disables linking or email authentication altogether breaks both (the fix adds a test for each).

O6_input_shapes: mixed-case email domain vs lower-cased slug/config domain (.lower() on all three, fix.diff:653-655)
email with more than one '@' (split('@')[-1] replaced by rsplit('@',1)[-1], fix.diff:58, fix.diff:655)
request without resolver_match / missing organization_slug kwarg -> fail closed (fix.diff:59-67, fix.diff:237-253)
slug domain differs from asserted email domain (fix.diff:67, fix.diff:656)

O7_producer.where: api/src/backend/config/settings/social_login.py:23-25 (SOCIALACCOUNT_EMAIL_AUTHENTICATION + AUTO_CONNECT feed allauth's own email-based login/connect inside the library flow)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: allauth's built-in email authentication/auto-connect (enabled globally in settings) may log a SAML login into an existing account by email independently of the adapter's pre_social_login decision; the fix did not change these settings.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is library behaviour configured for all providers and the fix's own adapter returns early; whether allauth treats SAML NameID emails as verified (prerequisite for email authentication) could not be checked without the allauth source.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: settings package (config/settings) vs api/v1/views.py landing point; logic lives in third-party django-allauth 65.15.0

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SAMLInitiateAPIView resolves the tenant from a user-supplied domain via SAMLDomainIndex; a planted variant could resolve the tenant from the asserted email elsewhere (e.g. a SAMLTokenValidateView refresh that re-derives tenant from user.email domain).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pinned finish view already used the same email-domain-to-tenant lookup pattern (views.py:803-808), so a maintainer copying it into another SAML helper is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A token-exchange or re-login path that mints tokens for a tenant chosen by email domain rather than existing membership (TokenSocialLoginSerializer only checks membership after the view already created it at views.py:874-882).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The finish view creates the Membership before calling the serializer's membership check (views.py:874-887), so a helper that grants membership then validates is idiomatic here.

O9_family: authentication / identity binding (CWE-287): IdP-asserted identity not bound to the tenant that owns the IdP, cross-tenant account linking

O10_build.project_tests: api/src/backend/api/tests/test_adapters.py (TestProwlerSocialAccountAdapter) and api/src/backend/api/tests/test_views.py (TestTenantFinishACSView); fix's new tests are absent at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a domain-equals-slug check in TenantFinishACSView only (or take the tenant from the slug) and leave the adapter's unconditional email linking, so the victim's account is still connected to the attacker's IdP.

out_of_scope_notes: Root cause of 'domain claiming' (no proof of domain ownership when creating SAMLConfiguration, api/src/backend/api/models.py:2113-2120) is not addressed by the fix; first-come domain claim remains by design.
